scripts.build: pnpm --filter @trioforge/crucible build:transformer && pnpm --filter @trioforge/crucible build && pnpm --filter @trioforge/crucible-sample-game build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('build', { recursive: true })" && rojo build examples/sample-game/default.project.json -o build/sample-game.rbxl
scripts.test: pnpm run build && lune run test && node --test test/sample-build.test.mjs test/studio/verification.test.mjs
scripts.check: vp check && stylua --check test .lune probes && selene test .lune && selene --config probes/engine/selene.toml probes && node --test probes/engine/verification.test.mjs && pnpm run test && pnpm --filter @trioforge/crucible test:transformer
